notes.title: Post your gameplay videos in our “WONDERFUL Twitter Campaign”!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/6a36ad9542fed4ececec0fb44f01661f0f0f1477.jpg[/img]

[h2]Post your gameplay videos in our “WONDERFUL Twitter Campaign” to celebrate the release of “The Wonderful One: After School Hero” free DLC![/h2]

We are celebrating the release of “The Wonderful One: After School Hero” free DLC. Come and celebrate with us by posting gameplay videos on Twitter from [b]The Wonderful One: After School Hero (Part 1)[/b] and [b]The Wonderful One: After School Hero (Part 2)[/b]! Your awesome videos may be used on the PlatinumGames official social media channels. Our dev team will choose their favorite videos from those submitted and some may even land you an [b]awesome prize[/b]!

[h2]The “WONDERFUL Twitter Campaign”[/h2]

[u][h3]POST YOUR VIDEOS BETWEEN…[/h3][/u]
Friday, May 26, 2023, and Friday, June 9, 2023, 14:59 Universal Standard Time (UTC)

[u][h3]IF YOU WANT TO PARTICIPATE…[/h3][/u]
1. Follow the PlatinumGames official Twitter account. You can follow either the [url=https://twitter.com/platinumgames]English-language account[/url] or the [url=https://twitter.com/platinumgames_j]Japanese-language account[/url]
2. Post your “The Wonderful One: After School Hero” free DLC gameplay video on Twitter with the following hashtag:
[b]#wonderful1gameplay[/b]

The video may include gameplay from Drill 1, Drill 2, Drill 3 or Drill 4.
You may apply as many times as you like.

[h3][u]VIDEO REQUIREMENTS[/u][/h3]
Your videos will need to meet the following requirements.

Your video must be a directly captured video of the gameplay without any editing or doctoring performed to it. You are free to directly capture the video in any way you want. However, we cannot accept videos recorded by filming your monitor with your smartphone, tablet, or similar device’s camera.
Your videos must include your own gameplay, not clipped footage of other players’ gameplay.
Your videos must be 15 to 30 seconds in length.
Once the application period has closed, we will contact the winners via direct message (DM) from one of our two official Twitter accounts.

We will ask winners to provide the video data they submitted to Twitter, so [u]please do not delete the video data until the winners have been announced.[/u]

[h3][u]CONDITIONS FOR PARTICIPATING IN THE CAMPAIGN[/u][/h3]
You need to agree to the Terms and Conditions of the campaign.
You need to have a Twitter account and make sure that your tweets are not set to protected (i.e. not a “locked” account).
You need to agree that your submitted videos may be used in the PlatinumGames’ advertising materials (on websites, social media, etc.)
Note: If you are a minor, you must obtain the consent of your parent or guardian.

[u][h3]REWARDS FOR THE BEST GAMEPLAY VIDEOS[/h3][/u]
The development team will check out your gameplay data, and pick out the ones they like the most! Thise chosen will be posted to the official PlatinumGames website and social media, and we may use them in official PlatinumGames trailers.

[h3] [u]“YOU’RE WONDERFUL!” Award[/u][/h3]
Your gameplay videos will be broadcast on our YouTube channel/social media ads, etc., with your Twitter account name displayed on them. We will create a compilation sizzle reel of all the winners’ gameplay videos and will post it on our official PlatinumGames YouTube channels around the end of June.

We will choose up to 40 winners in total for this award (Up to 20 for Drill 1 and Drill 2 gameplay videos, and up to 20 for Drill 3 and Drill 4 gameplay videos)

When we notify you that your videos have been selected, we will ask you for permission to use your video for our YouTube channel and social media advertising efforts. If you agree to have your videos used in this manner, we will send you instructions and request you to upload the videos you have captured. Please note that there is a possibility that we may edit out the sound from your video when we use your video for our own promotional purposes, so we ask that you keep this in mind when participating in the campaign.

[b][u]BUT WAIT![/u] [/b]There’s more! Our dev team will look through all the “YOU’RE WONDERFUL!” Award winners and will pick out the videos they think are particularly awesome! If your video is one of those chosen, we will present you with one of the following Amazon Gift Cards depending on the award you receive.

[h3][u]“THE WONDERFUL ONE” Award[/u][/h3]
[i]Selected by Hideki Kamiya, Supervising Director of “The Wonderful One: After School Hero”[/i]

We will choose 2 winners in total for this award (1 winner for Drill 1 and Drill 2 gameplay videos and 1 winner for Drill 3 and Drill 4 gameplay videos).
Note: Winners nominated for other awards will not be eligible for this award.

Winners will receive one of following Amazon Gift Card versions.
Note that the use of the gift card is limited to its region.
We will only send you the gift card code.

[i]United States: 105 USD
Canada: 145 CAD
United Kingdom: 85 GBP
Germany: 100 EUR
Spain: 100 EUR
France: 100 EUR
Japan: 15,000 JPY[/i]

[h3] [u]“AFTER SCHOOL HERO” Award[/u][/h3]
[i]Selected by Yuji Nakao, Producer of “The Wonderful One: After School Hero”[/i]

We will choose 2 winners in total for this award (1 winner for Drill 1 and Drill 2 gameplay videos and 1 winner for Drill 3 and Drill 4 gameplay videos).
Winners nominated for other awards will not be eligible for this award.

Winners may choose one of following Amazon Gift Card versions.
Note that the use of the gift card is limited to its region.
We will only send you the gift card code.

[i]United States: 70 USD
Canada: 95 CAD
United Kingdom: 60 GBP
Germany: 65 EUR
Spain: 65 EUR
France: 65 EUR
Japan: 10,000 JPY[/i]

[h3][u]“WONDER GOGGLES” Award[/u][/h3]
[i]Selected by Yosuke Matsumura, Director of “The Wonderful One: After School Hero”[/i]

We will choose 10 winners in total for this award (5 winners for Drill 1 and Drill 2 gameplay videos and 5 winners for Drill 3 and Drill 4 gameplay videos).
Winners nominated for other awards will not be eligible for this award.

Winners may choose one of following Amazon Gift Card versions.
Note that the use of the gift card is limited to its region.
We will only send you the gift card code.

[i]United States: 35 USD
Canada: 45 CAD
United Kingdom: 30 GBP
Germany: 30 EUR
Spain: 30 EUR
France: 30 EUR
Japan: 5,000 JPY[/i]

Prizes are due to be sent in July, 2023.

[u][b]TERMS AND CONDITIONS[/b][/u]
– Each individual may apply to participate in the campaign as many times as they wish. However, the same gameplay video cannot be used multiple times to apply.
– All applicants for this campaign must agree to the terms and conditions before applying for the campaign. If the applicant is a minor, please make sure to obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before applying for this campaign.
– Applying for this campaign deems that you have agreed to these Terms and Conditions and, if you are a minor, to have obtained the consent of your parent or guardian before applying for this campaign.
– A Twitter account is required for this campaign. Please apply by tweeting in accordance with our specified application method and conditions.
– Entry conditions are as follows. Tweets that meet all conditions will be eligible for video selection.
1) You must be following the official PlatinumGames Twitter account “@platinumgames”.

Applications that fall under any of the following points will be disqualified from the campaign.
1) Participants that do not comply with the terms and conditions and application procedures.
2) Participants that have set their Twitter account to private.
3) Content which does not comply with PlatinumGames’ gameplay video distribution guidelines:
https://www.platinumgames.com/guidelines/
4) Content that infringes on the intellectual property rights, honor, trust, privacy, or other rights of PlatinumGames, other users, or other third parties, including proprietary rights and copyrights.
5) Content of the video that offends public order and morals.
6) In addition to the above, anything that PlatinumGames deems inappropriate.

– Participants are responsible for all costs incurred in applying for this campaign.
– The right to participate in this campaign may not be transferred or lent to any third party, whether with or without compensation.

[u][b]SELECTING THE WINNERS[/b][/u]
– Winners will be selected from among the applicants after in-house selection at PlatimumGames.
– PlatinumGames is not able to respond to inquiries regarding selection.

[u][b]ANNOUNCING THE WINNERS[/b][/u]
After internal selection, winners will be notified by direct message (DM) on Twitter from the official PlatinumGames account.
Please note that we will not be able to contact the winners if they are not following our official Twitter account.

[u][b]PRIZE DELIVERY[/b][/u]
We will be sending out the Amazon Gift Card codes to the winners during July 2023.
The Amazon Gift Card codes will be handed out to the winners in the following manner.
1) PlatinumGames will send a direct message (DM) to the winners using the direct message (DM) function on Twitter.
2) In the direct message (DM), we will send the pertinent details and a Google Form created by PlatinumGames. Please fill out the form within one week of the notification.
3) We will send the Amazon Gift Card code to the winner via Twitter direct message (DM) at a later date, after confirming all the pertinent information.

In the following cases, winners will be deemed to have declined prize acceptance.
1) When the winner does not fill out the Google Form within 2 weeks from the date of receiving the prize notification direct message (DM).
2) When the winner unfollows the official Twitter account “@platinumgames” before the prize is sent.
*If you have not received your prize after one month from the date of sending your reply direct message (DM), please let us know via the DM.
*The right to receive prizes, whether paid or unpaid, may not be transferred or lent to a third party.

[u][b]INQUIRIES[/b][/u]
If you have any inquiries about this campaign, please feel free to contact us via the below form.
https://www.platinumgames.com/company/contact/tw101r/


[u][b]HANDLING OF PERSONAL INFORMATION[/b][/u]
All personal information of applicants will be handled in accordance with the PlatinumGames Privacy Policy as stated on our official website.
https://www.platinumgames.com/terms-of-service/
Personal information will be used only for the purpose of notifying the results of the campaign, sending prizes, and responding to inquiries, and will be discarded after a reasonable period of time has elapsed after the prizes are sent.

[u][b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/u]
– PlatinumGames reserves the right to change, suspend or discontinue this campaign at its discretion. PlatinumGames shall not be held liable for any such modification, suspension, or discontinuation, except in cases of intentional or gross negligence on the part of PlatinumGames.
– PlatinumGames shall not be held liable for any damages incurred due to the operating environment of Twitter or related applications in connection with this campaign.

[u][b]OTHER[/b][/u]
– PlatinumGames reserves the right to change these terms and conditions without prior notice if it deems it necessary.
– This campaign is not related to Twitter or Twitter Inc.

notes.title: A new free DLC “The Wonderful One: After School Hero(1 & 2)” available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/e7f8ba590c9ccb83c5de211b63ee467505a2811e.png[/img]

Get ready for a unique side-scrolling experience in the world of The Wonderful 101: Remastered! This free DLC lets you enjoy a brand new episode in which you experience Luka's story!

The Wonderful One: After School Hero tells the story of Luka, who is aiming to become a full member of the Wonderful 100. Players control Luka in a side-scrolling experience and take down oncoming enemies with Luka’s trusty lasers. Oh, and Luka is an elementary school kid! Go get’em tiger!
Luka spends his days in special training Drills after school as he aims to complete the CENTINELS training program. As the latest member of the CENTINELS, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

[h1]The Wonderful One: After School Hero
(Part 1 and Part 2) DLC[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353290/The_Wonderful_101_Remastered__The_Wonderful_One_After_School_Hero__Part_1/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353300/The_Wonderful_101_Remastered__The_Wonderful_One_After_School_Hero__Part_2/

As the latest member of the CENTINELS, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

[b]Thrilling SIDE-SCROLLING action[/b]
Jump into classic side-scrolling action with a PlatinumGames twist. Get ready for a super-exciting experience as you blast away a bunch of enemies with your awesome lasers!

[b]Super-fun LASER shooting[/b]
Luka uses his trusty Stingy Eye goggles to shoot a variety of lasers that decimate his foes. Use the Right stick to freely shoot lasers in any direction!  2-D  has never felt so simple, fun, and intuitive! You have three laser types at your disposal. Blast away, young recruit!

[b]A variety of MODES to keep you enticed[/b]
Go hands-on with The Wonderful One: After School Hero in two different modes. The Arcade Mode lets you experience the story of how Luka became the full-fledged hero Wonder Goggles. The Challenge Mode lets you select and play any Drill of your choice. Try to clear all the unique missions set in each Drill and see if you can find some hidden areas on each stage. Re-play the game to your heart's content to explore every nook and cranny!

Important note: This DLC was made possible by reaching the stretch goal of our February 2020 crowdfunding campaign. We would like to extend our sincerest gratitude to the 33,199 amazing fans who supported us on this journey.

notes.title: A new free DLC “Time Attack” is out now!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that our new free DLC that adds a Time Attack mode is now available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/7bff2ab25515c4f1fcd2236fed88f13158344d7e.png[/img]

[h1]“Time Attack” DLC[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/15d9c117dd80a699ee1f7a11628313405884c287.png[/img]

A new way to experience the 100-hero Unite Action spectacular The Wonderful 101: Remastered has just made the scene in the form of a free DLC game mode!

Time is a purely action-focused challenge in which you can try your hand at beating stages as fast as possible. Non-essential cutscenes let you blast through the stage of their choice stress-free, and when trying to outdo yourself, you can keep an eye on the new Record Gauge to see how you're stacking up against your personal best! You can also upload your times to online rankings and see how you compare to Wonderful Ones from around the world!

[b]*Warning: stages that have not been completed in Story Mode will be selectable in Time Attack Mode, so beware of spoilers.[/b]

To the mighty heroes who've banded together across the globe to repel the GEATHJERK invaders, we present this Time Attack in gratitude. 
[b]UNITE UP[/b] and see how fast you can save the planet again!

This DLC was made possible through a crowdfunding stretch goal supported by 33,199 fans, who we'd like to thank from the bottom of our hearts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/2086e19c6bde0dd4580aeb15bca6070630ebb95d.png[/img]

[h1]Hideki Kamiya Protects the Earth at Mach Speed LIVE![/h1]

To celebrate the first anniversary and the release of the Time Attack DLC, we held a live stream called "Hideki Kamiya Protects the Earth at Mach Speed LIVE!".  You can watch the archive with English comments here:

[previewyoutube=MROdDmO91LY;full][/previewyoutube]

More DLC is coming in the future, so stay tuned!

notes.title: The Wonderful 101: Remastered Wonder-Size Cadet Demo & Ver. 1.03 Patch is out!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that the Wonder-Size Cadet Demo for [i]The Wonderful 101: Remastered[/i] is now available.
Check out the trailer first!
[previewyoutube=4l3wLVcKHDQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Wonder-Size Cadet Demo[/h1]

As the name suggests, this demo delivers Wonder-Size amount of content, including Platinum-level epic boss battles and a lot of in-game goodies! Enjoy the prologue and all of Operation 001, a total of about two hours of gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/a854723a7434b4bfd7be5da6929fb4fb9efea360.png[/img]
A lot of bonuses like in-game currency and a selection of support items are also available from the start of the demo, so that even beginners can set off on this dynamic adventure fully equipped.

Best of all, you can transfer save data from the demo to the full version and pick up right back up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/3009a91c47114bfd10868b624e9a1b307108527c.png[/img]

[h2]Wonder-Bayonetta[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/9b9284b7695f49d4e6afe7cbde9fce0a3c12151a.png[/img]

The hidden character Wonder-Bayonetta can be used from the start of the demo.
She can be chosen as the leader at any point during an operation, and has a special Unite Morph!

[b]Unite Morph: Scarborough Fair[/b]
[list]
[*]Draw a Unite Gun sign to Unite Morph.
[*]Firing all four guns at once, this attack has a large effect radius.
[/list]
[b]Special Abilities:[/b]
[list]
[*]Dodge enemy attacks with the right timing to enable Witch Time, slowing down enemies in the vicinity.
[*]Summon Gomorrah for a special dodge maneuver by pressing the Dodge button.
[/list]

Unite up with Wonder-Bayonetta and play the free demo version of the game now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190400/The_Wonderful_101_Remastered/

[h2]Wonderful Codes[/h2]

The v.1.03 patch adds a new in-game “Wonderful Code” feature to The Wonderful 101: Remastered, allowing players to enjoy the same bonuses as the demo, as well as many others! Don't forget to update to the latest version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37649106/494e048a4ed081e6b69c67ea89e2197361413c67.png[/img]

To celebrate the release of the Wonder-Size Cadet Demo, we're sharing two in-game Wonderful Codes:

Vol.1 [b]UMBRANGIFT[/b]
Unlocks “Wonder-Bayonetta"

Vol.2 [b]ANGELSLAYERS[/b]
Unlocks "Wonder-Jeanne" and "Wonder-Rodin"

Be on the lookout for more Wonderful Codes!

[h1]Ver. 1.03 Patch[/h1]
The latest patch is out now! For more details please check the following:

[b]Patch details:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Added a new "Wonderful Code" feature. [/b]
Certain hidden elements of the game can now be unlocked by entering officially released codes.
[*][b]Added a demo save data transfer feature.[/b]
When starting a new game, save data from the demo can be detected and transferred, allowing players to continue from the end of the demo.
[*][b]Fixed a number of bugs.[/b]
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190400/The_Wonderful_101_Remastered/

Stay healthy and safe!
